'It's our time': Sunshine Silver CEO says silver miners are poised to shine as AI fuels demand
items.summaryEn: (Kitco Commentary) - Artificial intelligence may be dominating investor conversations, but one mining executive said that investors are increasingly recognizing a simple reality: AI cannot exist without the metals that power it. In an interview with Kitco News, Heather White, CEO and Director of Sunshine Silver Mining & Refining, said that she was pleased with the results of her company’s IPO last month. She said investor reception reinforced a growing appreciation that silver producers are becoming strategically important as demand for critical minerals continues to accelerate. The company completed its IPO in June, raising gross proceeds of approximately $310.5 million after underwriters exercised their full over-allotment option. Sunshine sold 23 million shares at $13.50 each and began trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker SSMR.
